machine.free.title: Free up space
machine.free.merged.one: 1 folder of a merged or closed PR
machine.free.merged.other: {count} folders of merged or closed PRs
machine.free.crew.one: 1 folder of a finished crew job
machine.free.safe: Branches stay, and replying to a task brings its folder back
machine.free.unsafe: Look first: nothing brings these back
machine.free.confirmBody: No task uses them, so nothing brings them back, uncommitted changes included.
machine.free.next: By itself, the next cleanup removes clean folders of merged PRs, Done tasks after a day, and the rest after {days} idle days. Uncommitted work, kept folders and open PRs stay.
machine.free.off: Automatic cleanup is off: folders stay until you remove them.
